test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states was the Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Yojana launched in May 2021 to provide financial assistance for the medical treatment to all the residents?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot announced to implementation of a Universal Health Scheme named ‘Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Yojana’ from May 1, 2021. 
 
• The scheme will provide free annual medical insurance of up to INR 5 lakh for every family in the State.
 
• It will also cover the beneficiary of ‘Ayushman Bharat – Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthya Bima Yojana (AB-MGRSBY)’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Capital of Rajasthan- Jaipur
 
• Chief minister- Ashok Gehlot (May 2022)
 
• Governor -Kalraj Mishra
